The '''Anoat sector''' was a subsector of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the worlds of the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]] and a majority of the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]]. It bordered [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]] closely so that both sectors could be monitored with little trouble, and were jointly called the "Twin Nebulae Sectors". [[The Ring/Legends|The Ring]] was a nebulosity also located in Anoat sector.

The sector capital was [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]], at the intersection of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]], and the [[Nothoiin Corridor]]. The systems of the Ison Corridor included [[Varonat system/Legends|Varonat]], [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin]], [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat]], [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth]], and [[Ison system/Legends|Ison]]. Major worlds outside the Ison Corridor included [[Bendeluum/Legends|Bendeluum]], [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]], [[Mexeluine/Legends|Mexeluine]], and [[Kirtarkin/Legends|Kirtarkin]]. Other worlds within the sector, mostly concentrated around the Ivax Nebula included [[Ione/Legends|Ione]], [[Burnin Konn/Legends|Burnin Konn]], [[Allyuen/Legends|Allyuen]], [[Tokmia/Legends|Tokmia]], [[Isis/Legends|Isis]], [[Mataou/Legends|Mataou]], [[Ertegas/Legends|Ertegas]], [[Ozu/Legends|Ozu]], [[Bavva/Legends|Bavva]], [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]], [[Doaskin]], [[Council (planet)/Legends|Council]], [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]], [[Zhanox/Legends|Zhanox]], [[Polmanar/Legends|Polmanar]] and [[Mijos/Legends|Mijos]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Anoat sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
